rag.text:
Test: TC-594 — Feature area - Task Dependencies - Circular relations between tasks in Gantt module
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-54 Feature area - Task Dependency
Labels: teamspace

Steps:
1. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-594 / TC-597 Circular relations between tasks in Gantt module
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed
2. Click on endpoint on the the right side of taskbar and drag the cursor to the end of targetTask
   Data: taskbar: TC-594 Child 1
targetTask: TC-594 Parent 1
   Expected: Dependency cannot be created. Error message is displayed:
Can't edit/add a new dependency, as it would create a circular relatioship.
3. Click on endpoint on the the right side of taskbar and drag the cursor to the end of targetTask
   Data: taskbar: TC-594 Child 3
targetTask: TC-594 Child 4
   Expected: Dependency cannot be created. Error message is displayed:
Can't edit/add a new dependency, as it would create a circular relatioship.
4. Click on endpoint on the the right side of taskbar and drag the cursor to the end of targetTask
   Data: taskbar: TC-594 Child 5
targetTask: TC-594 Child 7
   Expected: Dependency between Tasks "TC-594 Child 5" and "TC-594 Child 7" is created.
5. Select taskName on WBS
   Data: taskName: TC-594 Child 8
   Expected: Task is highlighted. Task "TC-594 Child 8" is linked with task "TC-594 Parent 4"
6. Indent taskName
   Data: taskName: TC-594 Child 8
   Expected: Dependency cannot be created. Error message is displayed: +XXX+ wasn’t moved as it would cause a circular dependency.
7. Click on key of taskName to open Jira issue view
   Data: taskName: TC-597 Child 9
   Expected: Jira issue view is opened in new tab
8. Navigate to Jira Administration -> Manage apps and disable BP plugin
   Expected: BP is disabled
9. Go back to Jira issue view of taskName and make a link passing this set of data
   Data: linkType: has to be finished together with
targetTask: TC-597 Child 10
   Expected: Link is created
10. Navigate to Jira Administration -> Manage apps and enable BP/BG plugin
   Expected: BP/BG is enabled
11. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-594 / TC-597 Circular relations between tasks in Gantt module
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed

After enabling plugin one of link that is causing circular relation should be deleted from Jira and from Gantt.
